# Jeremiah 42 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 42:1 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-all the-commanders-of the-forces and-Johanan son-of Kareah and-Jezaniah son-of Hoshaiah and-all the-people from-small to-great approached, |
| LOGOS | Then all the commanders of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, came near |
| PNEUMA | Then all the military commanders, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, along with all the people from the least to the greatest, came to Jeremiah |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 42:5 (overlap: 20%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they said to Jeremiah, "May-YHWH be between-us a-true and-faithful witness, if-not according-to-every word which YHWH your-God sends-you to-us — so we-will-do." |
| LOGOS | Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act according to all the word with which the LORD your God sends you to us." |
| PNEUMA | They said to Jeremiah, "May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we don't do everything the LORD your God tells us to do through you." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

|---|---|

| LOGOS | "If you will remain in this land, then I will build you up and not pull you down; I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I relent of the disaster that I did to you." |
